text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's stay sharp out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Oh dear, this won't do.
I must brace myself and stay focused.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're early, McQueen!
It's not even our meeting time yet.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-chan is all smiles♪
She must've been looking forward to practice that much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: T-That is not what I meant at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I simply wish to achieve good results in the U.A.F. as well.
So, um—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if my shoulder's aching to throw, or that
I can't get enough of how brand-new gloves feel!
I am not thinking about any such things—no, never!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Well, let's just give it a shot for now!
First up, McQueen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Wham!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Low and inside, pierced through!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nice pitch, McQueen-chan♪
You looked just like a real baseball pitcher!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
I couldn't help but feel like
I was standing on the mound myself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, this won't do.
Treating this like make-believe was terribly frivolous of me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Why? It hit the target, so
I don't think it matters what feeling I threw it with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However... isn't it frivolous?
I should be practicing seriously, yet it's like I'm just playing around...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true!
I saw you giving it your all
with every single pitch, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when it comes to sports,
you improve faster when you enjoy them. So there's really
no need to hide how much fun you're having, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I agree completely♪
I think improving while having fun will be much better for you, McQueen-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Do you... think so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... did getting so carried away
make me look childish—

text_block_list.name: Ryan & Ines
text_block_list.text: That's not true! It's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both very much!
I shall make sure to thoroughly enjoy myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled!
I shall pitch them one after another!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha♪ Being bashful has its charm, but lively McQueen-chan is just the cutest!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Seeing her full of energy makes me happy too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's keep practicing tons too!
We can't afford to lose to McQueen, after all!
